title: Security Systems Engineer (CCTV, Access Control & Biometric)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Rudra Shield is a premier personal security service provider offering tailored solutions to businesses, corporate clients, and high\-profile individuals across India. The company combines elite security personnel, intelligent operations, and advanced technology to address complex security challenges in corporate offices, industrial sites, events, and for high\-net\-worth clients. With a mission to make India safer, Rudra Shield delivers flexible and scalable services that integrate with each client’s operational workflow. The organization emphasizes integrity, accountability, and trust, supported by rigorous training and continuous development for its security professionals. Team members work in a culture focused on professionalism, client partnership, and protecting what matters most to each business.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Security Systems Engineer (CCTV, Access Control \& Biometric) role based in Gurgaon. The Security Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, installing, configuring, and maintaining CCTV, access control, and biometric systems for client sites, ensuring reliable and secure operation. Daily tasks include assessing security requirements, preparing system layouts, integrating hardware and software components, and conducting system testing and commissioning. The role involves diagnosing and resolving technical issues, performing preventive maintenance, and providing on\-site technical support and training to clients and internal teams. The engineer collaborates with project managers and security personnel to optimize system performance, adhere to safety and compliance standards, and document configurations, changes, and incident reports.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Systems Engineering and Systems Design skills relevant to CCTV, access control, and biometric security solutions.
* Hands\-on experience in Troubleshooting and Technical Support for security systems and related networked equipment.
* Proficiency in System Administration for security platforms, including configuration, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of IP networking, cabling standards, and integration of hardware and software components in security environments.
* Ability to read and create technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and documentation for installations and upgrades.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Relevant certifications in security systems, networking, or vendor\-specific technologies (e.g., CCTV, access control platforms) are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work on\-site in client\-facing environments.
* Willingness to work in Gurgaon and travel to client locations as required for installation, support, and maintenance activities.

title: Distributed Systems Engineer (High-Throughput Ledger & Sync)
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon / Remote (Hybrid / Flexible Work Policy)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 3–6 Years
   

  

**Industry\-Standard Salary Range:** 
 22 LPA – 38 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 Our company builds mission\-critical B2B SaaS architecture operating at the demanding intersection of global supply chain logistics and high\-throughput fintech settlement rails. Our platform ingests millions of inventory telemetry events, transactional ledger movements, and vector search queries every single hour. Maintaining absolute data consistency, partition tolerance, and low latency across distributed nodes is the core engineering challenge that keeps our platform running smoothly.
   

  

 We believe that building resilient distributed systems requires deep architectural discipline, rigorous concurrency control, and clean, modular code. If you are passionate about solving hard problems in distributed consistency, event sourcing, and high\-concurrency database states, you will find your ultimate engineering home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking an elite, hands\-on
 **Distributed Systems Engineer** 
 to take full ownership of our core ledger synchronization and transactional state replication engine. In this role, you will design, build, and scale distributed backend services that guarantee ACID compliance and high availability across multi\-region cloud deployments. You won't just write standard CRUD endpoints; you will architect fault\-tolerant consensus mechanisms, optimize network partition recovery, and ensure that our financial ledgers and supply chain telemetry remain perfectly synchronized under massive enterprise load.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Distributed Architecture: Design, build, and scale low\-latency distributed microservices and consensus\-driven backend architectures using Go, Rust, or Python.
* State Synchronization: Implement event\-sourcing patterns, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), and distributed locking mechanisms to handle high\-concurrency transactional updates.
* Database Partitioning \& Sharding: Architect and manage horizontal database sharding, cross\-region replication, and eventual\-consistency models for large\-scale enterprise data stores.
* Resiliency \& Fault Tolerance: Build robust retry logic, circuit breakers, dead\-letter queues, and automated failover systems to handle network partitions and service degradation gracefully.
* Performance Profiling: Conduct deep bottleneck analysis, memory profiling, and network payload optimization to achieve sub\-millisecond internal response times.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with data engineering, DevOps, and product squads to align distributed system capabilities with evolving business requirements.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional backend software engineering experience focusing heavily on distributed systems, concurrency, and high\-throughput data processing.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in systems programming or backend engineering using Go, Rust, or Python, combined with advanced understanding of networking protocols (TCP/UDP, gRPC, HTTP/2\).
* Database \& Messaging Expertise: Hands\-on experience with distributed databases (CockroachDB, Cassandra, or distributed PostgreSQL setups) and event streaming brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Theoretical Foundation: Solid grasp of the CAP theorem, consensus algorithms (Raft/Paxos), distributed transactions (2PC/Saga patterns), and vector clock synchronization.
* Engineering Mindset: Strong system design capabilities, meticulous debugging skills, and a proactive ownership mentality.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-leading salary package (22–38 LPA) structured with base pay, performance bonuses, and meaningful equity participation.
* Cutting\-Edge Tech Stack: Total freedom to work with modern distributed computing primitives and high\-scale enterprise architecture.
* Growth \& Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and your dependents, plus an annual learning stipend for tech conferences and advanced training.

**Company Description**
 Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Northern India area.
   

  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: Applied AI Systems Engineer
description:
**About Disha** 




 We believe the future of healthcare is one where everyone carries a personal doctor in their phone—someone who knows them, understands their health journey, and is accessible whenever they need support. Disha is a step toward that future. Disha is an AI health coach that supports people through personalized, ongoing conversations across chat and voice. We are building it to make healthcare more proactive, continuous, and accessible—not limited to the few minutes someone spends with a doctor.
 



  





**Disha launched on September 20, 2025** 
 . Nine months later, as of June 20, 2026:\-
 


* More than 500,000 people used Disha monthly.
* In May alone, users spoke with Disha for over 3\.2 million minutes an exchanged more than 6 million chat messages.
